lessons: She follows through best in the 17:30-19:00 habitual evening window and on weekends, with physical or outdoor opportunity. Evenings had 93% completion; mornings and afternoons were weaker, as were social and psychological-capability contexts. Intensity 3 is less reliable, so I spread those tasks across separate evenings. Long tasks go in large weekend windows, planning tasks in evening slots, and alongside tasks near related activities.
